_comment: THE OFFICE EDIT PROTOCOL, v1. This file is byte-identical in
against it, and both assert its sha256, so a change on one side that is
not mirrored on the other fails there rather than silently drifting.
Every value here is a LITERAL. A fixture that computed its own
expectations would agree with whatever the code did.

scope.reason: Office.js has no transaction across context.sync(), so a batch that fails halfway cannot be rolled back.

request.forbidden_reason: The client sends material, never digests. A client-asserted binding is the client's claim about itself, and a replay would only need to repeat an old hash.

response_duplicate.note: The duplicate check runs BEFORE the token check, so a replay reports duplicate rather than burning the token and reporting unknown_token.

request.note: The pane reports what Word actually did. 'applied' is never assumed.

response_ok.note: digest is null WITH a reason when it cannot be read; it is never invented, and a consumer that needs it must refuse rather than proceed.

audit_unwritable.note: An edit that cannot be recorded must not happen.

client_obligations.no_retry_on_execute: execute mutates. A timeout does not mean the request was not received, so it is never retried.
client_obligations.unknown_reason_is_an_error: A refusal reason this client does not recognise is reported as unrecognised, never passed through as understood.
client_obligations.digest_required_for_identity: An execution with no served-model digest is refused: a mutable tag cannot say which weights answered.
